This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Spanish specification.

Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of Spanish appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of Spanish in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of Spanish.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
